news.headline: Is CrowdStrike Stock Paying You Enough For The Swings?
news.summary: You may own CrowdStrike (CRWD), a cybersecurity company whose shares rose 5.1% in five sessions as the S&P 500 fell 1.2%. You likely hold it beside an index fund, and your whole account swings more when one holding jumps. Have the gains on CrowdStrike been big enough to pay for those swings.

news.headline: PANW Hits Record High As AI Safety Debate Continues To Boost Cybersecurity Stocks — Analysts See Cyber Spending Upside
news.summary: Morgan Stanley raised its PANW target to $410 from $394 recently, calling it a key beneficiary of increased cybersecurity spending, according to TheFly.

news.headline: Cloudflare at $350: AI Cybersecurity Threats Aren’t Enough to Move the Needle Now
news.summary: Cloudflare has surged nearly 80% this year on the back of an AI security boom, but the stock now trades at a multiple that punishes any stumble. The next two earnings reports will determine whether this rally was justified or priced for perfection.

news.headline: Zscaler Tanked Over One Year: A Prominent Firm Says 50% Gains to Arrive in 12 Months or Less
news.summary: While cybersecurity peers doubled in value over the past year, Zscaler slid past 30% and now sits at a crossroads where one bold analyst sees a very different story unfolding than the rest of Wall Street is willing to admit.

news.headline: Bot Traffic Will Be “1000X” Bigger Than Human Traffic in Just Five Years, According to Cloudflare CEO
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCloudflare CEO Matthew Prince says automated traffic could become 1,000 times human traffic within five years if current trends continue. More than 20% of the web sits behind Cloudflare’s network, putting the company in the path of rising AI-agent and bot traffic.
